caseStudy.title: ConnectClub
caseStudy.lead: A members' club app for taxi drivers: sign in with Face ID, verify a driving licence by photographing both sides, carry a member badge and unlock offers from partner companies.

brief.title: The brief
text: The club gives taxi drivers access to offers from partner companies. Membership had to be tied to a real driving licence.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the native iOS app in Swift and UIKit.
Implemented sign-in and registration with biometrics.
Built licence verification: photograph the front and back, crop with Mantis and upload.
Showed partners and their offers from the backend through Alamofire, with a Home tab and an Account tab.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Drivers join with a verified licence and get a badge that unlocks partner offers.
